review_candidates.title: Cloud Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The company maintains strategic partnerships with global technology leaders such as AWS, Google, Microsoft, and SAP, enabling it to offer cutting-edge services and robust infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for the operational management and continuous improvement of our sovereign cloud platform, ensuring the highest standards of stability, security, and compliance. Qualifications More than three years of professional experience in designing, implementing, and operating network
eligibility_evidence: About The Company Arvato Systems, a subsidiary of Bertelsmann, is a leading international IT service provider with approximately 3,500 employees worldwide.
As a part of Arvato Systems, you will be part of a global network, gaining exposure to international markets and advanced cloud technologies.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: With a strong emphasis on technical expertise, industry knowledge, and customer-centric approaches, Arvato Systems develops, integrates, and manages digital processes, cloud solutions, and IT systems for its clients. Your expertise will contribute to the development and maintenance of a resilient, secure, and compliant network environment, supporting the digital transformation efforts of our clients. Qualifications More than three years of professional experience in designing, implementing, and operating network infrastructure, preferably within SDN environments. Proficiency in programming languages such as C#, C++, Java, Python, or Perl. You will have access to comprehensive onboarding programs, including exclusive training sessions with Microsoft specialists, to enhance your technical expertise.

review_candidates.title: Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Position Description: Systems Engineer The IT Systems Engineer will be responsible for maintaining, securing, and improving Insite's internal technology ecosystem. Key Responsibilities: Administer and maintain the health, security, and performance of Insite's core technology ecosystem, including Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Exchange Online, Intune), Jamf MDM, Meraki networking, Slack, Zoom/Zoom Phone, Smartsheet, and Druva inSync backup. Manage identity and access administration in Microsoft Entra
eligibility_evidence: This is an individual contributor role reporting directly to the Director of Security Technology, ideal for someone who enjoys owning a diverse stack end-to-end and working independently in a hybrid office environment.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This role serves as the primary technical point of contact for our IT vendors and platform providers, and will play a hands-on role in engineering new solutions as the company's needs evolve. Assist the Director in handling ad-hoc technology requests and projects as required Required Experience and Skills: 3-6 years of experience in a systems engineer, systems administrator, or IT infrastructure role. Hands-on administration experience with Microsoft 365, including SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, and Intune. Exposure to security frameworks or compliance requirements relevant to professional services firms.
